title: fragaria norvegica
intro: Fragaria norvegica, commonly known as the Norwegian woodland strawberry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is known for its edible fruits, which have been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, potentially reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria norvegica include its potential to exhibit antimicrobial, antidiabetic, and antihypertensive activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid. These bioactive compounds have been reported to contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine and potential pharmaceutical applications.
